name: Tiny Planet
shortDescription: Walk a tiny planet and find the crystals before nightfall.
description: Tiny Planet is a little world of your own to explore. A round explorer walks a planet grown from a word you choose, with continents, mountains, forests, and seas, and the horizon curves away under their feet as they go. Crystals are hidden across the land, each sending a beam of light into the sky, and the sun sets for real while you look: noon blue turns to an amber sunset, then stars and a rising moon. Find every crystal before dark to save the planet, and your time is the score to beat. It plays on a phone with a thumb stick and on a desktop with the keyboard and mouse, with three worlds to pick from (meadow, tundra, and ember), each with a light and a dark title screen. Name the planet and the explorer, and pick how long the day lasts and how many crystals to hide.
setup: Your agent asks: "What's your planet called, what's your name, and which world do you want (meadow, tundra, or ember)?" It picks a seed word for the planet, which you can change to grow a different one, and it can make the day longer or shorter and hide from 1 to 24 crystals. No accounts or keys are needed. The game is one folder of files you can host anywhere, and best times stay on each player's device.
